name: Caroline’s Wedding Sandwiches for a Crowd
time: ~2 hr 30 min, ~30 min hands-on (mostly resting; estimated)
notes: A hit when served as a picnic lunch after Caroline’s wedding in Oakland.

items: 2 loaves (1 pound each) unsliced Italian bread
1 pound thinly sliced fully cooked ham

steps.title: Hollow the bread
steps.body: Slice **2 loaves (1 pound each) unsliced Italian bread** in half, longways, and take out some of the bread in the center.

steps.title: Make the spread
steps.body: Mix together and spread on bottom and top of each loaf: **1 package (8 ounces) cream cheese, softened**, **1 cup shredded cheddar cheese**, **¾ cup sliced green onions**, **¼ cup mayonnaise** and **1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce**.

steps.title: Layer the meat
steps.body: Layer on bottom and top of each half: **1 pound thinly sliced fully cooked ham** and **1 pound thinly sliced roast beef**.

steps.title: Add the pickles
steps.body: Place in middle: **12 to 14 thin slices dill pickle**.

steps.title: Wrap and rest
steps.body: Gently close sandwiches and wrap tightly in saran wrap for at least 2 hours.
